svg.title: V10 · Selection · paired light and dark synthetic design
svg.desc: Ordered picks, confirm, Undo and partial failure. Two 1080 by 2340 synthetic S24+ design frames; not runtime screenshots. Content has distinct spatial controls and alternate state panels. Assumed 72px status/navigation insets, V09 488px keyboard. Touchable implementation minimum 48dp; actual dp and rendered font must be checked.
